title: PRD: Production readiness for the live demo
summary: Requirements for making the CareRoute Azure demo production-ready: automated ordered CI deploys, observability, login hardening, PHI access logging, least-privilege DB roles, and accurate ops docs.
scope: CI deploy pipeline (GitHub Actions, GHCR, OIDC)
notes: Status: Draft. R1 is marked done 2026-09-24; R2-R8 are open. It references ADR-0006..0009 as a range, and ADR-0001 is cited for the deploy order.
